title: Espaces Irradies
identity: Antoine Tisné's *Espaces irradiés* is for alto saxophone and piano. The Philharmonie guide lists four movements and the Choudens number AC 20883; AC 20823 belongs to the following work, *Music for Stonehenge*. Billaudot's composer catalog also lists a 1983 recording by Claude Héraud and Roger Muraro.
